preconditions.description: n is an even number between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= 2 * 10**5 for x_i in even_positions)
preconditions.description: Each element in the even positions list is between 1 and 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output starts with either 'No' or 'Yes'.
If the output is 'No', there are no additional numbers.
If the output is 'Yes', there are n + 1 numbers following 'Yes'.

postconditions.expression: return_value.startswith('Yes') implies all(1 <= x_i <= 10**13 for x_i in restored_sequence[1:])
postconditions.description: All elements in the restored sequence (excluding the first) are between 1 and 10^13.

postconditions.expression: return_value.startswith('Yes') implies all(restored_sequence[i] == even_positions[i//2] for i in range(1, n+1) if i % 2 == 0)
postconditions.description: The elements at even positions in the restored sequence match the input even positions.

postconditions.expression: return_value.startswith('Yes') implies all((sum(restored_sequence[:i+1]))**0.5.is_integer() for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The cumulative sum of the restored sequence up to each position is a perfect square.
